pr_title: Fix filtering editor nodes in Create Dialog
pr_body:
Fixes #72033

The create dialog opened from 2D editor uses CanvasItem as base type, which wasn't caught by the old condition.

issue_context.title: Editor nodes not filtered on the 'Create CanvasItem' window
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.beta15.official [4fa6edc88]

### System information

Windows10, Forward+, AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics

### Issue description

Users can only add Control and Node2D nodes on the Create CanvasItem window, but there are Editor nodes not filtered out. 


### Steps to reproduce

Right-clicking on the 2D viewport. Select the add node feature. A Create CanvasItem window shows. Users can only add Control and Node2D nodes, but there are Editor nodes not filtered out.
![图片](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/80319225/214565483-98717565-c2e5-41d8-83a0-a985a96fc595.png)

### Minimal reproduction project

No project is needed.
comments: This is not a regression, the issue also exists in 3.5

I think EditorSpinSlider is here by design, because it's an exposed node that is also available in exported projects if I'm not mistaken. It was exposed because people commonly asked to have its functionality in exported projects. (We ran out of time to rename it for 4.0, or merge its functionality with SpinBox.)

review_comments: Cached for performance. No reason to check it each time.
